## 0. Working title and one-paragraph story
**"How much shorter can a prediction-powered interval be? Headroom over PPI++ when labels, unlabeled data and the predictor are all fixed."**

Prediction-powered inference (PPI, PPI++) turns a fixed predictor into a valid interval for E[Y]. The classical semi-supervised / missing-data theory gives a variance floor V* = σ²_res/n + V_g/(n+N).
